QuestInfo.0: It looks like #bDylan#k needs to say something. Talk to #bDylan#k.

speech.1: I don't think we can wait for the Swingboat. We have no idea when it will be fixed. I understand your excitement, #bDylan#k, but... well, there's plenty to do here. Why don't we just walk around a bit?

default.0: Talk to #bDelilah#k and let me know what she says.
